classes.name: Выборы депутатов Верховного Совета Приднестровской Молдавской Республики (1990-1995: Верховный Совет ПМССР/ПМР)
classes.finest_note: Each deputy is elected in a single-member district; the Central Election Commission publishes the winner and vote shares by district.
classes.note: Elected for five years. The first Supreme Council (1990-1995) had two equal chambers, the Council of the Republic and the Council of Nationalities, chosen in 63 districts on 25 November 1990. Under the 1995 election law the 1995-2000 Supreme Council had a Chamber of Legislators of 32 and a Chamber of Representatives of 35 deputies, the latter elected in seven territorial districts. The constitutional reform of 21 June 2000 made it unicameral with 43 deputies in single-member districts by simple majority (Electoral Code of 9 August 2000); from the VII convocation (2020) it has 33. An election is valid only if at least 25% of registered voters take part.

cadence.runoff_rule: Simple majority in single-member districts (Electoral Code of 9 August 2000)

classes.name: Выборы Президента Приднестровской Молдавской Республики
classes.finest_note: Votes by city and district; the Central Election Commission reports turnout by polling station.
classes.note: Elected directly for five years, at most two terms in a row (Constitution art. 60). A candidate needs more than half the votes cast; otherwise the top two meet in a second round, as on 25 December 2011. A Vice-President was elected on the same ticket until the office was abolished in 2011. Before the first popular vote, the Supreme Council elected Igor Smirnov Chairman of the PMSSR on 29 November 1990 (see the class chairman_1990).

cadence.runoff_rule: More than half of the votes cast; otherwise the top two in a second round

classes.name: Судьи
classes.disposition_reason: Judges are appointed under chapter 5 of the Constitution; the Electoral Code provides only for the President, the Supreme Council, the local Councils, the heads of village and settlement administrations, and referendums.

classes.name: Выдвижение кандидатов партиями
classes.disposition_reason: Candidates are nominated by voters' initiative groups, parties, and blocs and registered by the election commissions; no public primary is held or published.
